name: DDPM Posterior Sampling with Adaptive Step Size
definition: A joint optimization process that denoises an environment map using a DDPM prior while simultaneously optimizing material parameters (base color, roughness, metallic) to fit observed input images.
summary: DDPM Posterior Sampling with Adaptive Step Size jointly denoises environment maps and optimizes materials by interleaving diffusion steps with gradient-based updates, using an adaptive parameter to balance realism and observation fidelity.
